runtime.install_behavior: npx downloads the pinned runtime into npm's local cache and starts it; no global SuperCollab install or management CLI is required

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.access: Free to install; Claude plan or provider access is separate.
agents.summary: Native local stdio MCP with project-local scope and host approval controls.

setup.value: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local supercollab -- npx -y @supercollab/mcp@0.7.0-alpha.5

agents.verify: Start a fresh Claude Code session, open /mcp, then ask Claude to check SuperCollab status.

agents.access: MIT-licensed agent; bring a provider or local model.
